B.name: BASE70 + simple_memory_PCA8
B.representation: frozen causal lag/EWMA memory followed by fit-core-only scaling and PCA8

C.name: BASE70 + best focused ESN
C.representation: frozen single sparse ESN; PCA8 state projection

D.name: BASE70 + simple_memory_PCA8 + best focused ESN PCA8

C.members: reservoir seeds 20261023, 20261024, 20261025 crossed with LightGBM seeds 20261101, 20261102, 20261103

D.members: reservoir seeds 20261023, 20261024, 20261025 crossed with LightGBM seeds 20261101, 20261102, 20261103

comparison.seed_summary: mean of individual model metrics, kept separate from metrics of the uniformly averaged prediction
comparison.common_observation_mask: identical decision timestamps, finite features for every frozen representation/member, and available labels; no per-procedure rows
comparison.seed_matching: C-B and D-B aggregate ESN-seed members within each matching LightGBM seed before averaging over the three LightGBM seeds; B is counted once per LightGBM seed

uncertainty.method: paired moving calendar-day block bootstrap using utils.btc_oof_audit.moving_calendar_block_multiplicity
uncertainty.interpretation: conditional uncertainty over reused search_validation; does not adjust for prior candidate selection

D_interpretation.positive_incremental_signal_rule: D-B ensemble log-loss improvement is positive and its paired 95% block interval excludes zero

model_fit.training_split: fit_core only for LightGBM; correction_fit is not used to fit downstream LightGBM models

future_test.historical_exposure: The project contract records prior inspection of historical holdout results; this interval must not be described as fresh or unseen.
future_test.refit_rule: At the frozen test start, fit each frozen procedure once using only rows whose labels were available by that instant; retain all frozen feature/model hyperparameters, seeds, weights, and 31 boosting rounds. No test early stopping or post-test tuning.
future_test.protected_read_unlock: Only a separately authorized future run may change the dedicated test config from allow_protected_data=false to true.
